Our performance polos are designed to be a regular fit. If you are in-between sizes or prefer an athletic fit we recommend sizing down. 

The polo for every season

Engineered with DRICOMFORT® GEO 365, this polo delivers year-round performance without compromise. The technology embeds natural mineral and ceramic particles directly into the fibers, never as a coating, creating permanent moisture-wicking and fast-drying capability that won’t wash out. Moisture wicking and fast drying permanent wicking and fast-drying technology developed with embedded minerals that enhance comfort and performance all year around. UPF 50+ sun protection to help protect your skin during long days on the course.

Premium quality fabrics that are soft to the hand, hold their shape, and are easy care resisting wrinkling and static cling.
